name: Greeter
description: Greets players with a configurable message; admins can reload the config.

commands.name: greet
commands.description: Greet yourself or another online player

config.description: Greeting text; %player% is replaced with the greeted player's name

messages.noPermission: You don't have permission to do that.

acceptance.text: /greet sends the sender the greeting with %player% replaced by their own name
/greet <name> sends the greeting to that online player and tells the sender greetedOther
/greet <name> for a player who is not online tells the sender playerNotFound
/greeter reload by a sender with greeter.admin reloads config.yml from disk and sends reloaded; later greetings use the new text
/greeter reload without greeter.admin sends noPermission and does not reload (checked in code, not via plugin.yml command permission)
/greeter without arguments or with an unknown argument sends reloadUsage (to admins)
